svg.aria-label: OpenID Connect for a backend flow: a server-side web app logs the user in at the auth provider with the authorization code flow, keeps the tokens in a server-side session behind a cookie, calls the backend with the access token as bearer token, and the backend (this library) verifies the token via the auth provider discovery document and JWKS.
